data_description_zh:
1. 國民健康訪問調查(National Health Interview Survey，簡稱NHIS)已被公認為監測
國民健康現況及變化趨勢之重要方法，在台灣，每隔四年進行一次的「國民健康
訪問調查」已先後完成 2001年、2005 年、2009年、2013年及 2017年共五次調
查工作。其中，2001 年鑒於國內外非法藥物與成癮物質濫用情形有日益嚴重趨
勢，考量其對健康之不良影響，2005 年首次加入藥物與毒品等成癮物質的問題，
並將調查擴大為「國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查」，且自2005 年起由家戶為抽樣
單位改以個人為抽樣單位，2009 年調查中初次導入「附加題組」(optional module)
方式及「電腦輔助面訪調查系統(CAPI)」，增加面訪之便利性、建檔效率與資料品
質。
2. 於民國2021 年至2022年辦理第六次國民健康訪問調查，並擴大將金門與連江兩
縣納入調查區域範圍。本次調查主要係延續 2009年以來所建立之調查資料蒐集
模式，以電腦輔助調查方式進行樣本個案之社區面訪與問卷自填，並以 2013 年
調查所開發之電腦輔助調查資訊系統為基礎，進行系統建置、功能新增與修正後，
運用於本次之社區民眾健康調查。
3. 本次調查以戶籍登記資料為抽樣母體清冊，依地區人口特性與調查執行之行政與
成本考量，分別於臺灣地區(含澎湖縣)以個人為抽樣單位抽選，並於金門和連江
兩縣以家戶為抽樣單位進行中選地址戶之實住人口全查。調查方式由訪問員運用
電腦輔助面訪調查系統，於各樣本區進行問卷訪查。考量不同年齡層之健康問題
差異，設計未滿 12歲、12至64歲以及 65歲以上三類問卷，結合運用核心問題
與附加題組，增加各卷可蒐集資料項目。實地訪查期間自 110 年10月至12月及
111 年 7 月至 11 月，臺灣地區完訪案數為 24,304 人，金門縣及連江縣分別完訪
800人及589 人。
(引述國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查工作團隊結果報告說明)

data_description_en:
1. The National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) is recognized as an important method for monitoring the current status
and trends of national health. In Taiwan, the NHIS, conducted once every four years, has completed five rounds
of surveys in 2001, 2005, 2009, 2013, and 2017. In 2001, in view of the increasingly serious trend of illegal drug
and substance abuse both domestically and internationally, and considering its adverse health effects, questions on
drugs and other addictive substances were added for the first time in 2005, expanding the survey into the "National
Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey." Also starting in 2005, the sampling unit changed from the household to
the individual; the 2009 survey first introduced "optional modules" and the "Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing
(CAPI) system," increasing the convenience of face-to-face interviews, data-entry efficiency, and data quality.
2. The sixth NHIS was conducted from 2021 to 2022 (ROC years 110-111), expanding the survey area to include Kinmen and Lienchiang
counties. This survey mainly continues the data-collection model established since 2009, using computer-assisted methods for
community face-to-face interviews and self-administered questionnaires, and builds on the computer-assisted survey information system
developed for the 2013 survey, with system enhancements, new features, and corrections, applied to this community health survey.
3. This survey used household registration data as the sampling frame.
Based on regional population characteristics and administrative
and cost considerations for survey implementation, individuals were sampled in Taiwan Area (including Penghu County), while
in Kinmen and Lienchiang counties, households were used as the sampling unit, with a full census of the actual resident population
of the selected address households. Interviewers used the computer-assisted personal interviewing system to conduct questionnaire
surveys in each sample area. Considering differences in health issues
across age groups, three types of questionnaires were designed—under
12, 12-64, and 65 and older—combining core questions with supplementary modules to increase the data items collected in each
questionnaire. Fieldwork was conducted from October to December 2021 (ROC year 110) and from July to November 2022 (ROC year 111);
the number of completed interviews was 24,304 in Taiwan Area, and 800 and 589 in Kinmen County and Lienchiang County, respectively.
(Quoted from the results report of the National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey working team)
